name: Equipment Exchange Co
old_description: Equipment Exchange Company specializes in the sales and marketing of your idle food processing equipment to a number of food industries, from processed meats to packaging and beyond. Our experienced team and vast inventory provide an excellent opportunity for our clients to turn their idle food processing equipment into cash. EEC is a value-added dealer that has been actively working through eeclink.com since 1996.
about:
Equipment Exchange Company operates from Lake City, Pennsylvania, near Erie, and has been active online through eeclink.com since 1996. The company's team brings over 40 years of combined experience in purchasing, refurbishing, and selling industrial food processing machinery, though the firm itself was established in 1996 as a value-added dealer.

The company purchases idle food processing equipment, refurbishes it, and resells it to food manufacturers. Its project scope ranges from single machines to complete facility liquidations, and it conducts both live and web-based simulcast auctions. Inventory categories span bakery, cooking and freezing, food preparation, labeling, material handling, packaging, refrigeration, and support equipment.

Equipment Exchange serves food processing sectors including meat processing, packaging, bakery, and prepared foods. Customers include plants looking to sell surplus assets and buyers seeking refurbished machinery from brands such as FMC Food Tech and Chester Jensen. The dealer markets equipment to processors across the region, leveraging its location equidistant from Pittsburgh, Cleveland, and Buffalo.

The firm positions itself as a value-added dealer that helps clients convert idle assets into cash through an experienced team and a large inventory. Its long-standing online presence since 1996 and auction capabilities differentiate it in the used equipment market.
